# hiok_api_management_policy (Resource)

A policy (rate limit, cache, header, CORS, …) on an API or one of its operations.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `api_id` (String)
- `kind` (String)

### Optional

- `config` (String) The policy's settings (JSON text).
- `enabled` (Boolean)
- `operation_id` (String) Limit to one operation.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
